hang_luu_hoa.wants: To ride at the head of the road before her mother is finished with it, and once to see her half-brother and learn whether the hostage is soft.
hang_luu_hoa.secret: She skims a tenth of every toll her mother's band takes into a jar buried behind the cup tent, to buy riders who will follow her and not Đồ Xích Linh.

sub: He rode in the raids as a young man
A camel-bell trader's son of Đà Linh Trấn, he rode in the raids as a young man
o_liet_phong.wants: A road where any small trader can join his train without fear, and enough saved to retire to Đà Linh Trấn with a ledger-house of his own.
o_liet_phong.secret: He has begun posting false legs on the Đà Linh board, routes his escort never rides, to see whether wrapped riders come for them; the day they do, he will know whose band it is, and Đồ Xích Linh reads that board.

cuu_lac_nhat.app: Black stains in the knuckles of his sabre hand that he has stopped scrubbing.

o_sa_nhi.add: Three horses have thrown her in a year; the riders call it her luck.
o_sa_nhi.app: A saddle-sore limp she hides by riding faster.

sub: An alley orphan of Đà Linh Trấn, he lost his first
man_xich_cau.app: A chipped front tooth and a laugh that starts before the joke.

hung_da_linh.add: A camel that knows the road carries him, and he sleeps through half of each leg.
hung_da_linh.app: The weave of a saddle blanket pressed into one cheek.

tat_da_lang.app: A neat wedge of beard he trims with a knife he swears was his father's.

liem_hoa_nhi.app: Hair singed short on one side where a cup-lamp caught it.

sub: she left in 1197 with her father's guard rota copied into her sleeve, when
thoi_kim_doi.app: A guard's blue sash cut down to a wristband she never takes off.

trac_hong_da.app: A horse-kick dent in his shin and one ear half lost to frost.

co_xich_nguyet.app: A cup-shaped scar between thumb and finger where her grandfather's jade cup split.

na_lac_linh.app: A voice cracked by shouting over camel bells, and a bell tied into her braid.

dan_muc_lang.app: Mare hair on every sleeve, and a face only the grey mare praises.

kieu_liet_ca.add: When a driver stumbles on the rope he cuts him loose and lets the others step over him.
kieu_liet_ca.app: Black veins climbing the back of the hand that holds the rope.

dieu_luu_ly.add: She charges the poorer riders double for a cup that cracks, and calls it the heat.
dieu_luu_ly.app: Burn-pitted forearms and glass beads she counts when no one watches.
